lines.en: One stride takes me half the hall.

lines.zh: 我的头几乎顶着天花板。
lines.en: My head nearly touches the ceiling.
I must stoop to pass the door.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在两层楼里响。
lines.en: My steps ring through both floors.
I come on slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我一边走，影子一边变长。
lines.en: My shadow lengthens as I walk.

lines.zh: 我抬高一条腿，跨过横梁。
lines.en: I lift a leg over a beam.
Three steps cross the entire corridor.

lines.zh: 我低着头，胳膊垂在两旁。
lines.en: Head down, arms hanging at my sides.
I keep close to the wall as I pass.

lines.zh: 我在灯的下面停了一拍。
lines.en: I hold one beat under the lamp.
My body is as tall as the door.
I stand with my head almost at the ceiling.
The lamp only reaches my chest.
My face is in the dark.
I am looking down at you.

lines.zh: 这里有回声，是我的脚步。
lines.en: There is an echo, and it is my steps.
I raise a hand to the height of my face.
My shoulder brushes the doorframe.
The lamp hums beside my face.
The air moves around me.
Breathing that loud, you can't hide.

lines.zh: 我的手指垂到了膝盖下面。
lines.en: My fingers hang below my knees.
This house cannot hold me.
When I lower my head, the lights flicker.
Not moving. Let's see how long you last.
My head is above the rafters.
I must stoop to see you clearly.
This house cannot contain me.
No need to run. One stride and I am there.

lines.zh: 我在你上面，可不在天上。
lines.en: I am above you, and not in the sky.

lines.zh: 你听见我踩在地板上的声音吗。
lines.en: Do you hear me on the boards?

lines.zh: 我低头，脸几乎碰到你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head; my face nearly meets yours.
This floor is too low.

lines.zh: 你的声音从我脚边上来。
lines.en: Your voice reaches me from my feet.

lines.zh: 我的手能盖住一整扇门。
lines.en: One of my hands could cover a door.

lines.zh: 你仰头，我的脸在灯影里。
lines.en: You look up; my face hangs in the lamplight.
I need not bend to take you.
Your neck strains to look up.

lines.zh: 我在这层楼里只能弯着。
lines.en: In this house I can only stay bent.

lines.zh: 你的影子只是我影子的一角。
lines.en: Your shadow is a corner of mine.

lines.zh: 我一步就跨过你整条路。
lines.en: One stride of mine spans your whole path.

lines.zh: 你要是跑，会先撞到我的腿。
lines.en: If you run, you will hit my leg first.
Look at my face a moment longer.

lines.zh: 我把手放低了，你能看见了。
lines.en: I have lowered my hand. You can see it now.

lines.zh: 这段走廊到门口就结束了。
lines.en: This corridor ends at the door.
That struck my shin.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，血滴在地板上。
lines.en: I stoop and blood drips to the boards.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，头碰到横梁。
lines.en: I step back and my head hits the beam.
I barely felt that.
Slowly I lower my body.
My shadow hits the wall and folds back.

lines.zh: 手垂到地板，指节还在动。
lines.en: My hand hangs to the floor, knuckles moving.
You put strength into that.
I am still on this floor.
The beat held.

lines.zh: 那点东西在我眼里很小。
lines.en: That is very small to my eyes.
I stoop to see it closer.
One reach and it is in my palm.
I cannot feel that much weight.
I pinch it up into the lamplight.
It made a sound in my hand.
Too light. I let it go.
It is off the beat. I do not want it.

lines.zh: 我伸下的手，比你的整个人长。
lines.en: The hand I lower is longer than your whole body.
I lack nothing.
You hit my shin.
I felt nothing.

lines.zh: 你退后三步，才看得见我的脸。
lines.en: Three steps back and you can see my face.
The ceiling scrapes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你踩响地板，我停下来听。
lines.en: You creak the floor; I stop to listen.
I lift a leg to let you by.

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞，我懒得低头。
lines.en: Not worth lowering my head for.
You ran into the front of my finger.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，走廊更暗了。
lines.en: I take a step back and the hall darkens.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖已经顶到你的头顶。
lines.en: My knee already brushes the top of your head.
I am the only one this size on this floor.
There may be others elsewhere.

lines.zh: 可它们都在很远的走廊尽头。
lines.en: But they are at the far ends of long halls.
Even at full stretch I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我在这条走廊走了很多年。
lines.en: I have walked this hall many years.

lines.zh: 回声是我唯一听见的声音。
lines.en: The echo is the only voice I hear.
I put my head to the wall and listen.
There is nothing in the wall.

lines.zh: 慢慢直起腰，天花板太低。
lines.en: Slowly straightening up. The ceiling is low.
This passage is still long.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一个很小的东西。
lines.en: I stoop for something very small.

lines.zh: 它在我指间几乎看不见。
lines.en: It is almost invisible between my fingers.
I hold it to the lamp.
Too large to hold.
I hold it between two fingers.
So light I nearly crushed it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，整条走廊都暗了。
lines.en: When I bend, the whole corridor darkens.
I do not need to collect these.
I bend and rise again.
My foot leaves a print in the board.
A small sound at the end of the hall.
I lower my head to listen.
It is between two doors.
One stride covers it.
Slowly I lift my foot.
It looks up at me.
And then it sees me.
It did not move. Neither did I.
My back bends into an arch.
My hand comes down in front of it.
The doorway is too low; I stop outside.
The frame will not stop me.
I put a shoulder through first.
This room is smaller still.
It has nowhere left.
I look down at it.
It is still in the corner.
I stand in the doorway and block the light.
It edges the other way.
I brace a hand on the wall.
My fingers are almost on it.
It crouches down.

lines.zh: 我低头时，走廊矮了一半。
lines.en: When I lower my head, the corridor halves.

lines.zh: 天花板压着我，我只能弯着。
lines.en: The ceiling presses me, so I stay bent.

lines.zh: 它开口说话了，声音很小。
lines.en: It speaks, very quietly.
I did not catch it.
It repeats itself.
I draw my hand back a little.
The room has gone quiet.
It runs for the door.
My leg is in the doorway.
It hits it.
I bend and reach.
No need to hurry for this.
Its hand feels along the wall.
Bent over, my head scrapes the doorframe.
My hand covers it.
I lift it up in my fingers.
It struggles in my palm.
The ceiling stops my hand.
I lower my hand a little.
It grips my fingers.
I close my hand gently.
Its bones sounded.
I hold my hand against my chest.
Its breathing is between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我松手，墙上的裂缝还在扩。
lines.en: I let go; the crack in the wall keeps widening.
I'm tall enough to hit the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我松开手，看着它落下去。
lines.en: I open my hand and watch it drop.
It has stopped. I straighten up.

lines.zh: 我直起腰，头顶到了横梁。
lines.en: I straighten and my head meets the beam.
This part is over.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头弯着腰过来。
lines.en: I come stooped from the end of the hall.
My head presses the ceiling.
This floor is far too low.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀侧过去，才过门。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder to get through the door.
The lamp only reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 我的影子填满了整条走廊。
lines.en: My shadow fills the whole corridor.

lines.zh: 我这么高，是幻觉量出来的。
lines.en: This height was measured by hallucination.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看着这一层。
lines.en: I lower my head and look along the floor.

lines.zh: 这里的回声比我慢半拍。
lines.en: The echo here lags half a beat behind me.
I raise a hand and touch the ceiling.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，我先出现影子。
lines.en: At the corridor's end, my shadow comes first.
I lower my head; the floorboard sags.

lines.zh: 我把一只手撑在门框上。
lines.en: I brace a hand on the doorframe.
The frame creaks under me.
I lower my head and draw my shoulders in.

lines.zh: 这一段走廊对我来说太窄。
lines.en: This corridor is too narrow for me.
I head for the lit doorway.
Dust falls with my steps.
I pause and listen.
Then I bend forward.

lines.zh: 火光把整个走廊照亮，我低下头。
lines.en: Fire lit the whole hall and I lowered my head.

lines.zh: 天花板塌了，我砸穿了两层。
lines.en: The ceiling gave and I fell through two floors.

lines.zh: 水只到我膝盖，可我躲不开。
lines.en: The water only reaches my knees, and I cannot escape it.

lines.zh: 爆响把我的身体掀得撞上墙。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the wall.
Something is in my leg.

lines.zh: 怪光顺着我的手臂往上爬。
lines.en: Strange light climbs my arm.

lines.zh: 我这么大，这里的吃食太少。
lines.en: I am this large and there is little to eat here.

lines.zh: 雷穿过屋顶，走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning came through the roof and down my body.

lines.zh: 地板塌了，我一直往下坠。
lines.en: The floor gave and down I go.
